rule: A supplier appears under a framework here ONLY because that framework's own NHS Supply Chain brief names it. Nothing is inferred from product ranges, specialities or catalogue categories. expiredRule: A brief whose framework has already ended is captured but kept OUT of `frameworks`, because every consumer reads that list as live routes to market. NHS Supply Chain leaves briefs published after they end. A brief with no readable end date stays in `frameworks` rather than being dropped.
